action.command:
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -c '
echo "=== Vite dev server :3036 (follow redirect) ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code} final_url %{url_effective}\n" -L http://127.0.0.1:3036/
echo "=== App entry JS via vite ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code} size %{size_download}\n" "http://127.0.0.1:3036/app/main.ts" 2>/dev/null
echo "=== dartsass output exists ==="
ls -la /workspaces/workspace/app/assets/builds/zammad.css 2>&1
' 2>&1
